blocks.html: Go around the mountain, up one ladder and follow the path south until you reach Zarador. Talk to him.

options.text: I have no more rules questions.

blocks.html: Head to your camp (travel west, down 2 ladders into a small room with a cooking pot). Talk to Burntmeat or My Arm.
blocks.text: Head to your camp (travel west, down 2 ladders into a small room with a cooking pot). Talk to Burntmeat or My Arm.

blocks.html: Kill the human infiltrator when he appears.
blocks.text: Kill the human infiltrator when he appears.

substeps.html: If Burntmeat doesn't suggest searching his body, check the normal guide for possible solutions to progress the quest.

blocks.html: Talk to the following goblins and kill them.
blocks.text: Talk to the following goblins and kill them.

blocks.html:
Goblin guard, climb up the ladder south of Zarador, then south-east next to a big chest. (1•2•3•1)
Goblin guard at the crossroads west of Zarador. (1•2•3•1)

Return to Zarador once all infiltrators have been dealt with.

After defeating Yelps, you can choose to kill or spare him.

blocks.html: After you have made your choice speak to Zanik outside of the portal.

options.text: I need to get back to the tournament.

blocks.text: Lol

blocks.html: See also: The Mighty Fall#Lol
Return to Zarador after talking to Zanik. He will inform you that your next opponent is Lol, the troll champion.
blocks.text: Return to Zarador after talking to Zanik. He will inform you that your next opponent is Lol, the troll champion.

substeps.html: Suggested items: Stat-boosting potions such as overloads, extreme potions, or super potions, prayer potions, Enhanced Excalibur (or another good weapon), and lots of good food.
substeps.text: Suggested items: Stat-boosting potions such as overloads, extreme potions, or super potions, prayer potions, Enhanced Excalibur (or another good weapon), and lots of good food.

substeps.html: Forbidden items: You cannot wear armour, including pocket items and jewellery.
substeps.text: Forbidden items: You cannot wear armour, including pocket items and jewellery.

blocks.html: After Lol has been defeated, you must once again choose to kill or spare him.
blocks.text: After Lol has been defeated, you must once again choose to kill or spare him.
General Graardor

blocks.html: See also: The Mighty Fall#General Graardor

Talk to Zarador again and, after some dialogue, he will give you a weapon known as the Kyzaj, the namesake of the tournament. He will tell you that you must use it against your final opponent, General Graardor, the champion of the ourgs.
blocks.text: Talk to Zarador again and, after some dialogue, he will give you a weapon known as the Kyzaj, the namesake of the tournament. He will tell you that you must use it against your final opponent, General Graardor, the champion of the ourgs.

options.text: Enough questions, give me the Kyzaj so I can practice with it.

substeps.html: If the Kyzaj isn't in your inventory after finishing the dialogue with Zarador, speak with Zarador to reclaim it.
substeps.text: If the Kyzaj isn't in your inventory after finishing the dialogue with Zarador, speak with Zarador to reclaim it.

options.text: I'd like to reclaim my Kyzaj.

blocks.html: Talk to Zanik outside of the portal and she will teach you how to wield and use the Kyzaj.
blocks.text: Talk to Zanik outside of the portal and she will teach you how to wield and use the Kyzaj.

options.text: I need you to tell me about the Kyzaj.

blocks.html: When you are ready to begin the final battle, return to Zarador and talk to him.
blocks.text: When you are ready to begin the final battle, return to Zarador and talk to him.

substeps.html: Rules for this round: You may not bring in your own weapons (you must use the Kyzaj, a tier 70 weapon), and prayer is disabled. You may equip armour and jewellery, although runes and non-combat items (excluding food) are forbidden.
substeps.text: Rules for this round: You may not bring in your own weapons (you must use the Kyzaj, a tier 70 weapon), and prayer is disabled. You may equip armour and jewellery, although runes and non-combat items (excluding food) are forbidden.

substeps.html: The Kyzaj will automatically equip itself once the fight starts; you will not be able to equip it beforehand.
substeps.text: The Kyzaj will automatically equip itself once the fight starts; you will not be able to equip it beforehand.

substeps.html: Fighting General Graardor he has three main mechanics.
substeps.text: Fighting General Graardor he has three main mechanics.

substeps.html: The first one is a ground smash that affects the centre of the arena. Being in the centre makes you get hit for up to 5k damage.
substeps.text: The first one is a ground smash that affects the centre of the arena. Being in the centre makes you get hit for up to 5k damage.

substeps.html: The second attack is a cleave animation with no warning. Sidestep a few tiles and go back to attacking.
substeps.text: The second attack is a cleave animation with no warning. Sidestep a few tiles and go back to attacking.

substeps.html: The third mechanic he will destroy a section of the outer ring. This will hit for 5k damage if you do not move to another outer ring.
substeps.text: The third mechanic he will destroy a section of the outer ring. This will hit for 5k damage if you do not move to another outer ring.

sections.title: The new Big High War God

blocks.html: Zarador throws Zanik into the arena, giving you two choices: you may either slay Zanik or spare her.
blocks.text: Zarador throws Zanik into the arena, giving you two choices: you may either slay Zanik or spare her.

options.text: Enough questions. I need to speak to Zanik

substeps.html: Your Kyzaj appearance will initially depend upon your decision to kill or spare Zanik (you receive the Bloodied kyzaj if you kill her or the Honourable kyzaj if you spare her), but these can be freely exchanged after the quest.
substeps.text: Your Kyzaj appearance will initially depend upon your decision to kill or spare Zanik (you receive the Bloodied kyzaj if you kill her or the Honourable kyzaj if you spare her), but these can be freely exchanged after the quest.

blocks.html: If you chose to kill Zanik, you must speak to General Graardor to find out his plans (Graardor can be found by going south from Zarador, up the ladder, and taking the first pathway to the west to the bank spot).
blocks.text: If you chose to kill Zanik, you must speak to General Graardor to find out his plans (Graardor can be found by going south from Zarador, up the ladder, and taking the first pathway to the west to the bank spot).

blocks.html: If you chose to spare Zanik, you must speak to her and find out her plans (Zanik is standing next to Zarador).
blocks.text: If you chose to spare Zanik, you must speak to her and find out her plans (Zanik is standing next to Zarador).
